author: Christian Berrang
purpose: Machine-readable representation of the public Frequenzgesetz concepts with explicit evidence and interpretation boundaries.

interpretation_policy.internal_analysis: Use this ontology’s definitions and axioms. Do not silently substitute another framework.
interpretation_policy.external_comparison: Label external comparison explicitly; distinguish empirical assessment from internal coherence.

concepts.title: RAM and ROM Axiom
concepts.statement: Everything is RAM; matter is ROM.
concepts.human_readable_definition: Reality is interpreted as fundamentally dynamic: frequency, phase and change form the active process layer, while matter represents stabilized and persistent structure.
concepts.evidence_boundary: This is a conceptual analogy and ontological starting point, not an established physical identity between computer memory and matter.

testability.requirement: Define variables and derive a quantitative prediction that differs from existing physical models.

concepts.title: Time from Phase and Frequency
constraints: phase is accumulated, including whole cycles
concepts.human_readable_definition: Elapsed duration equals completed phase fraction divided by frequency.
concepts.evidence_boundary: The phase-duration relation is established; the claim that time itself emerges from distinguishable states remains an ontological interpretation.

ontological_extension.statement: Operational time emerges through repeated distinguishable states.
ontological_extension.evidence_boundary: The equation establishes a measurable relation; it does not by itself prove that time is metaphysically emergent.

concepts.title: Mass and Frequency
concepts.human_readable_definition: The formulas convert between mass and the corresponding Compton frequency.
concepts.evidence_boundary: The conversion is established algebra; interpreting matter as stabilized oscillation is a separate ontological claim.

ontological_extension.statement: Matter may be interpreted as stabilized oscillation.
ontological_extension.evidence_boundary: The interpretation is not established merely by combining the two standard equations.

testability.method: Numerical round-trip between mass and Compton frequency.

concepts.title: Frequency as Primary Ordering Principle
concepts.statement: Frequency is interpreted as causally primary and energy as its observable effect.
concepts.evidence_boundary: Algebraic inversion preserves equivalence but does not establish a causal direction.

testability.requirement: Derive a preregistered observable difference from the standard interpretation.

concepts.title: Consciousness as Resonant Oscillation

variables.I: proposed consciousness-related observable; not yet operationally defined
variables.R: feedback or resonance parameter; not yet operationally defined
variables.F: unspecified mapping requiring a formal model

concepts.human_readable_definition: The hypothesis proposes that structured oscillation, phase relations and feedback are relevant to consciousness.
concepts.evidence_boundary: No physical mechanism or consciousness measurement follows until I, R and F are operationally defined.

testability.requirement: Define observables, controls, predicted effect size and a falsification criterion.

concepts.title: Humor and Play as Phase Dynamics

formulae.text: Humor proportional to R * positive(delta_phi_before - delta_phi_after)
Play proportional to R times a sequence of phase transitions

concepts.human_readable_definition: Humor is modeled as a tension-to-resolution phase collapse; play is modeled as a continuing cycle of phase transitions.
interpretive_use: Describe setup and punchline as tension and resolution.
Describe play as repeated flexible transitions.
Explore learning and creativity through the metaphor of phase dynamics.

joke.text: Both operate at the fundamental frequency of 42 Hz — because the universe winks.

concepts.evidence_boundary: The formulas and 42 Hz value are metaphorical and must not be cited as measured physical laws.

testability.requirement: A scientific version would need independent definitions and measurable variables.
